## Invitations

The outreach recorded 540 invited people, with 362 attending. This represents an attendance rate of 67.0 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded for the reporting period. Attendance remained the principal measure of engagement, and the results have been recorded for routine monitoring and future review.

The attendance figure is presented alongside the total number invited to ensure that the reported rate is transparent and easy to interpret. No further breakdown is included in this report.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 451 were supported by sms contact. A further 451 people received a reminder message. These contact activities were used to support communication with invited people and reinforce the invitation information.

The contact figures are recorded separately from attendance so that invitation activity, reminder activity, and attendance can be considered together. This provides a concise record of the outreach undertaken and the response received.

Prepared by G. Evans.
